title: Hum To Mohabbat Karega
desc: To pursue his love interest, TV reporter Geeta, Raju misleads the police with false clues during a murder investigation. His lies soon land him in trouble with the police and the mafia.

title: Shamitabh
desc: An aspiring actor with the inability to speak, joins forces with a man who has a powerful voice. Together they take the film industry by storm, but will their egos get in the way?

title: Desi Boyz
desc: A comedy-drama film about two friends, who lose their jobs during the recession. They decide to become male escorts to make ends meet, hiding their new profession from their families. However, their lives become more complicated when they fall in love and have to deal with the consequences of their new careers. Their lives take a turn when their secret is exposed, leading to a series of comical situations and misunderstandings.

title: One Two Three
desc: Three men named Laxmi Narayan—a wannabe hitman, a loyal aide to a powerful boss, and a women’s lingerie salesman—travel on business to Pondicherry and unexpectedly check into the same hotel.

title: Gulzar Dil (oru Naal Oru Kanavu Tamil) (dub)
desc: It's is a romantic drama about Cheenu, a young man who initially pretends to fall in love with Maya as part of a challenge. However, he eventually falls for her for real, and they must overcome family obstacles to be together.
